control_workstreams.current_gap: Live functional acceptance pending. Separate native cloud GET and historical remote refresh POST; no conflation.
control_workstreams.acceptance: GET cloud refresh plus separate POST wake/requestID workflow

control_workstreams.name: Remote vehicle refresh / Wake
control_workstreams.current_gap: Live functional acceptance pending. Reviewed wake and refresh routes, quota/cooldown/request-ID guards.
control_workstreams.acceptance: Explicit wake POST, JSON {}, bounded cooldown, requestID outcome

control_workstreams.name: Flash lights
control_workstreams.current_gap: Live functional acceptance pending. Native flash button, explicit capability and parked location required.
control_workstreams.acceptance: Capability honkAndFlash, physical test; never expose horn without explicit scope

control_workstreams.name: Start climatisation (stored)
control_workstreams.current_gap: Live functional acceptance pending. Stored/bodyless CARIAD start plus MBB parameterized start.
control_workstreams.acceptance: No settings -> bodyless POST, requestID lifecycle and state readback

control_workstreams.name: Climate target temperature/settings start
control_workstreams.current_gap: Live functional acceptance pending. 15–30 C setpoint, restore, temperature-bearing start; no start while off.
control_workstreams.acceptance: V2 current temp in climate entity; only explicit setting changes use validated payload

control_workstreams.name: Stop climatisation
control_workstreams.current_gap: Live functional acceptance pending. CARIAD and MBB stop; backend confirmation distinct from car state.

control_workstreams.name: Window heating action on/off
control_workstreams.current_gap: Live functional acceptance pending. Explicit window heat start/stop with separate buttons.

control_workstreams.name: Window heating settings + at unlock + 4 zones
control_workstreams.current_gap: Live functional acceptance pending. Six persisted setting switches and reviewed settings PUT.
control_workstreams.acceptance: GET settings then PUT reviewed body, no blind overwrite

control_workstreams.name: Start/Stop charging
control_workstreams.current_gap: Live functional acceptance pending. Explicit charging start/stop with bounded request status.
control_workstreams.acceptance: Separate start/stop, no blind retries, explicit selection

control_workstreams.name: Timed charging
control_workstreams.current_gap: Live functional acceptance pending. Timed charging through reviewed execute-action routing; verify actual schedule effect.
control_workstreams.acceptance: V2 semantics when supported, no guessed payload

control_workstreams.name: Charge mode manual/timer
control_workstreams.current_gap: Live functional acceptance pending. Native charge mode select and parameterized PUT.
control_workstreams.acceptance: PreferredChargeMode, not current chargeMode; preserve mode options

control_workstreams.name: Global charge target
control_workstreams.current_gap: Live functional acceptance pending. Native 20–100% number, step 5 and reviewed target PUT.

control_workstreams.name: Current location charge target
control_workstreams.current_gap: Live functional acceptance pending. Active profile ID resolved from reported profiles.
control_workstreams.acceptance: Resolve current charging profile ID from vehicle, don't guess

control_workstreams.name: Individual profile charge target
control_workstreams.current_gap: Live functional acceptance pending. Per-profile numbers use immutable ID, not profile name.
control_workstreams.acceptance: Stable unique_id based on immutable profile id; no name-key

control_workstreams.name: Preheater on/off
control_workstreams.current_gap: Live functional acceptance pending. Preheater switch and CARIAD auxiliary routes; legacy data parsed independently.
control_workstreams.acceptance: Legacy auth, security and status readback

control_workstreams.name: Auxiliary heating with duration
control_workstreams.current_gap: Live functional acceptance pending. Explicit duration and S-PIN guarded auxiliary service.
control_workstreams.acceptance: Duration 10–60m step10, compatibility and auth checks

control_workstreams.name: Lock/Unlock
control_workstreams.current_gap: Live functional acceptance pending. CARIAD PIN body and MBB challenge-response RLU; bounded completion.
control_workstreams.acceptance: Actual lock state, requestID, S-PIN and no retries

control_workstreams.name: Start/Stop engine
control_workstreams.current_gap: Live functional acceptance pending. Capability-restricted engine start/stop; no model-only permission.
control_workstreams.acceptance: Never auto-enable on Q8 without OEM capability and risk review

control_workstreams.name: Local dealer management
control_workstreams.current_gap: Live functional acceptance pending. Local dealer and service overview, config-only.
control_workstreams.acceptance: Local-only data, no Audi cloud request
